```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-micro
#| fig-cap: "Single-get microbenchmark"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
ops = ['CoordSpace get', 'HashMap get']; vals = [0.82, 8.50]
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(ops, vals, width=0.4, color=['white', 'white'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch=['///', ''])
ax.set_ylabel('Latency per lookup (ns)')
ax.text(0, 1.2, '0.82 ns', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
ax.text(1, 11, '8.50 ns', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('10.4x', xy=(0.5, 4), fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
